summary: A Doha private clinic serving corporate clients since 1987 appears to lose new patients to a site that says last updated 2013, a repeated welcome and a free builder address.

findings.problem: The footer appears to say Last updated: Saturday 14, September 2013 and Best viewed in Google Chrome or Firefox, pages may not appear in some versions of Internet Explorer.
findings.cost: A date from 2013 and a note about Internet Explorer tell a visitor the clinic may not be active, so they choose a clinic that looks current.
findings.fix: A current page with no outdated notes.

findings.problem: The welcome heading and line appear twice in a row on the homepage.
findings.cost: Repeated text looks careless and wastes the visitor's first few seconds.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address, with a Wix banner on the page.
findings.cost: A free builder address looks temporary for a clinic that advises large companies.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a clinic email.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp and no clear online booking appear, only a phone line with an extension.
findings.cost: Patients and company HR teams who want a quick answer message first, and the clinic that replies first gets the booking.
findings.fix: Online booking on the page and a one tap WhatsApp button.
